context.transcript:
Hi Diego, this is Julie calling from ENF to let you know that your 3D prototypes are ready for pickup.
We printed them using steel instead of plastic as you requested last week, but now they are really heavy, well over 40 pounds total.
I'm letting you know so you can plan how you're going to carry them.
Oh, you mentioned you're interested in working for us?
As it turns out, our junior designer has just left.
Anyway, we're open until six, so feel free to come any time before then.
Thanks!
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Diego，我是Julie从ENF打来的电话，想通知你你的3D原型已经可以取了。
我们用钢材而不是塑料打印它们，就像你上周要求的，但现在它们真的非常重，总共超过40磅。
我让你知道是为了让你能计划怎么携带它们。
哦，你提到对在我们公司工作感兴趣？
结果是，我们的初级设计师刚离职了。
无论如何，我们营业到六点，所以在此之前任何时间都可以来。
谢谢！
